pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries or averaging down within 50 pips of an existing active drawdown zone.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order-flow imbalance confirmation and 5-period ATR volatility normalization filter before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing locks at +$10.00 to prevent floating gains from eroding into sub-dollar or negative outcomes.
